examples.title: Water bill
examples.description: A quarterly residential water and wastewater bill. It shows an account summary, usage charts against the regional average, meter readings and charges by service, with a tear-off payment slip at the foot of the last page.

examples.title: Statement of account
examples.description: A business customer's statement of account across several properties. It lists every bill and payment with a running balance that carries across pages, and shows the opening and closing balances and what is owing by age.

examples.title: Works invoice
examples.description: A one-page A4 tax invoice to a builder for a new water connection and meter. It shows line items with GST per line and a discount, the subtotal, GST and total, payment terms, and a QR code that opens the online payment page.

examples.title: Letter to customers
examples.description: An A4 letter to residents about planned water main works in their street. It shows a letterhead on the first page, the address placed for a window envelope, merged fields in the text, a works schedule table and a signature block, with a short running header if the letter runs over.

examples.title: Operations dashboard
examples.description: Larkmere Water's one-page monthly operations dashboard for the board, on A4 landscape. Four KPI tiles that turn red when a target is missed, 12-month supply and response-time charts, complaints by category, and leaks repaired by zone and month.

examples.title: Meter readings report
examples.description: Larkmere Water's quarterly meter readings for the field operations team, on A4 landscape. A contents page of zones, then every reading grouped by zone with subtotals and a grand total, and unusual readings flagged.

examples.title: Backflow test certificate
examples.description: Larkmere Water's certificate that a backflow prevention device was tested, one landscape A4 page per device. Each shows the property, device, result and next test or re-test date, signature lines, and a QR code to verify it.

examples.title: Parts dispatch label
examples.description: A 4 × 6 inch shipping label for meters and parts sent from Larkmere Water's depot to a field crew, one page per parcel. Each shows the from and to addresses, parcel n of N, weight and contents, a Code 128 barcode and a DataMatrix code, and a FRAGILE or HANDLE WITH CARE stamp when the parcel needs it.
